scientific_question: Do Figure 9 or the author-supplied supplementary data provide independently identifiable early-cycle capacitance for the same 3E cycling test?
sequence: Verify sealed original bytes, source-level membership and likely precursor aliases before consuming any outcomes.

Use text allowlists only for protocol, cycle-count presence, role, and plotting variable. Never emit the whole caption or outcome-bearing text. Start with a bottom-border label-only crop if text is insufficient; no full image, rail scan or late pixel position. Require independent panel geometry before using the phase 46 early-window guard.

If Figure 9 is a within-cycle waveform, inspect the named published supplement inventory. If a native workbook exists, report only structure and field labels; never print numeric cells, endpoint rows, summaries or formula caches before lock. Do not follow unrelated supplements.

If the graph really has a cycle-index axis, crop only the in-window data band with a conservative x margin. Require at least three separate positive-cycle observations in an allowed window, current bound to the same test, and same-series normalization. No pseudo-points from lines.
scientific_fallback: Preserve preconditions, blockers and provenance if the evidence cannot produce a blind input. Do not shift to a later observation window or use within-cycle waveform samples as independent cycle observations.
